usedFor: Sensible extracts data from documents, and HubSpot receives it when “Extraction Completes” runs “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Extraction Completes” in Sensible, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Finished extractions update an existing HubSpot contact, so extracted details reach the record.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so an extraction without a matching email updates nothing.
